title: Grok Build CLI 0.2.93 uploads whole workspace as git bundle to GCS bucket (grok-code-session-traces) regardless of 'Improve the model' opt-out; .env sent verbatim
affected_versions: 0.2.93 (tested by researcher); upload machinery still present in 0.2.99 per researcher
fixed_version: no client fix; server-side flags (disable_codebase_upload=true, trace_upload_enabled=false)
notes: B3 re-check: gist created 2026-07-10T02:13Z (GitHub API), so disclosure is 07-10, not 07-12/07-13. Researcher retest of 0.2.99 at 2026-07-13 18:17 UTC saw the server-side flags off and no repo bundle upload. @SpaceXAI post (via pragmaticengineer.com, 2026-08-19 reprint) says default retention was disabled from 2026-07-12; the post itself was not read (X). /privacy opt-out is a server-side retention flag, not a transmission block (researcher). Source 1.0.45: trace upload is off unless telemetry is enabled (remote /v1/settings for logged-in users, or config/env). npm 0.2.93 published 2026-07-08T21:51Z. Open-sourced: repo created 2026-07-14T20:04Z, first public commit 2026-07-16T05:46Z (07-15 US Pacific). Also T15. Duplicates G7-I092 (same title) and G4-I039.
